game.name: Brink (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: BRINK is an essentially multiplayer FPS available on Xbox 360. The action takes place on the Ark, an artificial archipelago that has taken in thousands of climate refugees who have fled the rising waters. You play as either a representative of the authorities or a revolutionary who intends to overthrow the autocratic power. You will be able to take on the role of four different character classes in order to achieve the different objectives assigned to you.
